'''Zotti''' was a [[Rodian]] [[Jedi Initiate]] who was part of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. He was part of a group of new Jedi younglings including [[Bren]] and [[Linh]] who were brought to the [[Tenoo Jedi Temple]] from the [[Coruscant]] [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="YJA 201B">{{YJA|A Jedi or a Pirate}}</ref>  Later, he accompanied Bren, Linh, and fellow Initiate, [[Lys Solay]], on a guided tour of the [[Tenoo tree forest]]. There they encountered a [[Sharptailed Fellwing]], who gave Zotti a ride to her nest. After reuniting with his Jedi peers, Zotti joined them in watching several [[lightle bug]]s.<ref name="YITW" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zotti first appeared in "[[Younglings in the Wild]]," an animated short for the [[Disney+]] and [[Disney Junior]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]'',<ref name="YITW" /> which was released on [[August 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/young-jedi-adventures-season-2-and-nubs-shorts|text=''Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures'' Returns for Season 2}}</ref> The character was designed by [[Chris Blackstock]].<ref name="Blackstock">{{WebCite|url=https://blackstockart.com/young-jedi-adventures|text=Young Jedi Adventures|work=[[Chris Blackstock]]'s [https://blackstockart.com official website]|archivedate=20250306020751}}</ref>
